claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Federation conferences segregated visiting star peoples and kept them from questioning presentations; she cites Captain Gori'el's group as an example.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She characterizes the arrangement as suspicious and abusive.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Federation meetings showed visiting species images of Earth's wars; she reports her Antarian counterpart said two delegates were hospitalized after trauma. She alleges the imagery promoted fear of humans and support for Earth's isolation.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa, relaying her Antarian counterpart
claims.qualifiers: This is her counterpart’s report and her interpretation of the motive.

review_flags: The source makes contested political allegations, including reported harm to delegates and claims about Federation propaganda.
coverage_gaps: The video also argues that the New Age movement serves as a control mechanism and warns against generalizing whole species.
